title: Heavy Rain Alert Issued for Haridwar, India
summary: A heavy rain alert has been issued for Haridwar, India, with forecasters predicting heavy rainfall and strong winds on Monday. The decision to suspend public hearing in Haridwar was taken due to the heavy rain alert. The situation is being closely monitored by authorities.
summary_points: Heavy rain alert issued for Haridwar, India
Public hearing suspended in Haridwar due to heavy rain alert
Forecasters predict heavy rainfall and strong winds on Monday
Authorities are monitoring the situation closely
The decision was taken by local authorities
The impact of the heavy rain is being felt across the region

framing.center: Centrist coverage focuses on the practical implications of the heavy rain alert, including the suspension of public hearing and the potential disruptions to daily life. They also mention the importance of monitoring the situation closely.
framing.right: Right-leaning outlets focus on the severity of the weather conditions and the need for strict measures to be taken to ensure public safety. They also emphasize the role of climate change in intensifying extreme weather events.

framing_hi.center: केंद्रीय समाचार मुख्य रूप से व्यवधानों के संभावित परिणामों पर ध्यान केंद्रित करते हैं, जैसे कि जन सुनवाई की स्थगिति और दैनिक जीवन में उत्पन्न होने वाले व्यवधान। उन्होंने स्थिति की निगरानी करने की महत्ता भी उल्लेख किया है।
